biggest_catch: Your friend must open a new checking account within 90 days of membership and complete 5 debit card purchases totaling $50+ plus eStatements within 60 days - otherwise you get nothing.
catches: Referrer: UHFCU member 18+ who registers for the program and shares the offer; must be registered in the program.
Referrer earns a $50 Visa Reward Card per individual referred; 'A Referrer may receive up to ten (10) Reward Cards ($500 value) within a calendar year.'

Friend must: register for the offer, open a new UHFCU checking account within 90 days of establishing membership, and within 60 days: complete five (5) UHFCU debit card purchases totaling at least $50 AND enroll in eStatements.
Only one referrer may receive a Reward Card for each referred person who fulfills the requirements; referred person may also be eligible as a referrer.
Accounts must be in good standing at qualification; primary owner of the new account must have an SSN on file.
Referral good for up to 180 days; reward cards subject to terms delivered with the card; may be reported to the IRS.
Distinct from R4203, which covers the friend-side $100 Visa checking reward (uhfcu.com/score/) - this route is the referrer-side earning mechanism.

payout_quote: The person making the referral (Referrer) will earn a $50 Visa Reward Card for each individual referred (Referred Person) to University of Hawaii Federal Credit Union that registers for the offer, opens a new checking account and completes the other requirements. To make a referral, the Referrer must register for the program and share the offer with their friends, family or co-workers. Referring members must be 18 years or older to participate. A Referrer may receive up to ten (10) Reward Cards ($500 value) within a calendar year, but only one Referrer may receive a Reward Card for each Referred Person who fulfills the requirements.
payout_value_note: $50 Visa Reward Card to the referrer per qualifying referral; up to 10 per calendar year ($500).
